subject.title: Feature: Surface cron job name / session label in /status and statusline

question: Should OpenClaw accept the narrow shared status-summary display-label direction for `/status` and TUI status surfaces, or defer this to the broader status/usage attribution design?
rationale: The fix shape is bounded, but it changes user-visible session identity, the issue carries product-decision/no-new-fix-pr signals, and an open conflicting fork PR already claims the same issue.

options.title: Adopt narrow display-label path
options.body: Add label/displayName to the shared status summary and render it as the visible label in CLI/TUI status with raw-key fallback/detail.

options.title: Defer to JSON attribution design
options.body: Keep this issue blocked behind the broader status/usage attribution work so labels and stable identity fields are designed together.

options.title: Keep raw-key status behavior
options.body: Leave `/status` and statusline raw-key-first and treat friendly labels as picker-only metadata.

recommendation.title: Adopt narrow display-label path
recommendation.body: Add label/displayName to the shared status summary and render it as the visible label in CLI/TUI status with raw-key fallback/detail.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent history point to this person as the strongest status/TUI area routing candidate among the available history signals.
